audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart read Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs. The already-audited mirror (olaf__ziggs) settled the lane as Skill at Level 1, Olaf from Level 2 through first item, Skill at two-plus items — the near-inverse.
audit.why: Mirror agreement is mandatory and mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement introduced here. The mechanical case supports the mirror: Undertow reaches 1000 against your 850 Q, its cooldown resets on axe pickup, Reckless Swing is true damage, and Ragnarok removes the value of every slow you own. There is no level where Ziggs simply out-ranges him.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs in one atomic group, with all seven ratings moved with them so no row reads 'Olaf wins, 8/10', and the five contradicting why lines rewritten on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed Level 6 as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike and phases[5].why claimed first item as your Blackfire Torch spike. Both rows belong to Olaf.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s of disable immunity for as long as he keeps attacking, and Berserker Rage gives him attack speed and life steal that scale with missing health — the lower he gets, the better his all-in. Neither of your spikes changes that.
audit.corrected: Both why lines restated as his spikes, with the 100s timer written into spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states Undertow's 1000 range (longer than your Q), never states its 9s cooldown or the pickup reset as a number, and never mentions that Reckless Swing is true damage. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d were filler.
audit.why: Every practical rule in this lane comes from those numbers: you cannot stand outside the axe, only outside its line; standing on the axe denies the reset; and building resistances against Reckless Swing (325 range, true damage, 11s down to 7s) does nothing — the missing-interaction rule 'resistances-invalidated'.
audit.corrected: 1000 and 9s into phases[0].why, whys[0], whys[1] and breakdown.cooldowns; the true-damage rule into dontsFull[0].d and spikes[1].text; the reset restated in dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Step up only on its downtime' with no downtime given.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s, but he refunds it entirely by walking over the axe — so the real punish window only exists when he cannot retrieve it. Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, both slower than his axe.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d now carry 9s and 20s.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Olaf on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Undertow reaches 1000 to your 850 Q — level 1 is even, so poke from the far edge and never stand in a straight line.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: W Satchel online — your only escape. Undertow slows you into his reach, so save it for his step-up, not a trade.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Olaf can't read the angle.
edits.after: His level 3 spike: Undertow slows, the axe pickup resets it, and Reckless Swing deals true damage inside 325.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Ragnarok online: 100s of disable immunity while he keeps attacking. Your slows stop mattering — hold Satchel.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Olaf now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: His window: Berserker Rage gives attack speed and life steal as he drops, so chip trades feed his all-in.

edits.before: You out-range Olaf at Lvl 1 and poke him off the wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — Undertow reaches 1000 to your 850 Q.

edits.before: Lvl 2 he still can't reach you without a telegraphed axe.
edits.after: Lvl 2 the axe out-ranges you and its pickup resets it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you sidestep his axe and reclaim the poke war.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 one landed axe still closes the gap on you.

edits.before: Lvl 6 you respect Ragnarok but out-space him between his cooldowns.
edits.after: Lvl 6 Ragnarok ignores every slow you own — that window is his.

edits.before: Late your range and W self-peel keep you ahead of his gap-close.
edits.after: Late it evens out: your range against one uncounterable all-in.

edits.before: - Olaf Undertow (Axe): matchup-defining — Axe slows let him reach you — stand on the pickup spot to deny resets. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Satchel for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Olaf Undertow (Axe): matchup-defining — a 9s slow thrown 1000 units, reset the moment he picks the axe up, so stand on the pickup spot. - Budget W Satchel (20s) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Olaf whiffs Undertow (Axe) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: A whiffed Undertow he cannot retrieve is a full 9 seconds.

edits.before: That is Olaf’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is true damage from 325 — resists do not help.

edits.before: R Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to your Q and W slows and disables, so during his ult you cannot peel him — hold W Satchel Charge to knock yourself away and pre-drop E Hexplosive Minefield only knowing the slow won't stop him while it's active.
edits.after: Ragnarok is 100s at rank 1 and makes him immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, so your slows stop mattering — pre-drop Hexplosive Minefield before he pops it, hold Satchel Charge for the exit, and treat Reckless Swing as true damage.

notes: CONFLICT, RESOLVED TOWARD THE MIRROR: this side's packet says Ziggs 63.64% over 11 games with a Ziggs-leaning levelChart, while the already-audited olaf__ziggs settled the chart as Skill / Olaf x5 / Skill off a 54.97% lane figure. Per the mirror rule I matched the mirror rather than the packet, and the kit numbers back it (Undertow 1000 > Q 850, pickup reset, true-damage E, disable immunity on R). If the user wants the packet to win instead, this is the one file in the slice to revisit. Left unasserted because the kit text does not say: whether Satchel Charge's knockback still displaces Olaf through Ragnarok, and whether Ragnarok's immunity covers slows as well as disables — the existing prose already claimed slows, so I softened it to Riot's wording.
